question: How many players have been part of either the Sacramento Kings or the Chicago Bulls at any time?
gold_cypher: CALL { MATCH (n:Player)-[r0:playsFor]->(m0:Team {name: 'Sacramento Kings'}) RETURN n, m0 as m UNION MATCH (n:Player)-[r1:playsFor]->(m1:Team {name: 'Chicago Bulls'}) RETURN n, m1 as m } WITH DISTINCT n RETURN count(n)

question: List the names of players who have received the same awards as Buddy Hield, along with the count of such awards each has received.
gold_cypher: MATCH (n:Player)-[r0:receivesAward]->(m0:Award)<-[r1:receivesAward]-(m1:Player {name: 'Buddy Hield'}) WITH n, count(DISTINCT m0) AS num RETURN n.name, num

WHERE b.name = "Buddy Hield"
